typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		ENVRN_TXT as string,
		USER_FULL_NAME as string,
		USER_ROLE_LIST as string,
		USER_EMP_ID as string,
		RPT_DT as timestamp,
		DATABASENAME as string,
		USER_NAME as string,
		LAST_ACCESS_DT as timestamp,
		USER_EMAIL_ADDR as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'with sb as (   select o.*, dense_rank () over (order by RPT_DT desc) rn   from AWB_SCHEMA."USER_FEED" o ) select ENVRN_TXT   , DATABASENAME   , USER_NAME   , USER_FULL_NAME   , USER_EMAIL_ADDR   , USER_ROLE_LIST   , USER_EMP_ID   , LAST_ACCESS_DT   , RPT_DT   , GRANT_DT from sb where rn <= 3',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		ENVRN_TXT as string,
		USER_FULL_NAME as string,
		USER_ROLE_LIST as string,
		USER_EMP_ID as string,
		RPT_DT as string,
		DATABASENAME as string,
		USERNAME as string,
		LAST_ACCESS_DT as string,
		USER_EMAIL_ADDR as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		ENVRN_TXT,
		USER_FULL_NAME,
		USER_ROLE_LIST,
		USER_EMP_ID,
		RPT_DT,
		DATABASENAME,
		USERNAME = USER_NAME,
		LAST_ACCESS_DT,
		USER_EMAIL_ADDR)) ~> OLEDBDestination
